info.title: Positions DB
info.description: Identity-governed client holdings ledger (Aurora PostgreSQL). Rows are filtered to the caller's desk and PII/notional columns are masked by the caller's tier — enforced server-side by the caller's verified identity.

gatewayApiKey.name: x-meridian-api-key
gatewayApiKey.description: Shared API key injected by the AgentCore Gateway API_KEY credential provider (never supplied by the model/caller). The resolver validates it before running any query.

post.summary: Query the identity-governed client holdings ledger
post.description: Returns client holdings scoped to your desk. You cannot widen your own access: which rows you see (by desk) and whether client names / notional are visible (by your tier) are decided server-side from your verified identity. Optionally filter by sector, a minimum market value, and a row limit.

principal_sub.description: SERVER-INJECTED verified caller identity. Do not set this — any value you provide is overwritten at the gateway with your cryptographically-verified identity.

sector.description: Optional. Filter to a single sector, e.g. 'US Treasury', 'IG Corporate', 'Municipal', 'Agency MBS', 'TIPS'.

min_market_value.description: Optional. Only return holdings with market value at or above this amount (USD).

limit.description: Optional. Maximum rows to return (default 100, capped at 500).

200.description: Governed holdings rows (row/column visibility reflects your identity).
